tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Readiness check for a set of dependencies (e.g. an AI app's stack: chatgpt, claude, aws, vercel, supabase, stripe). Returns overall verdict (worst of the set), ready=true only if all are up, and per-service status. Use before running jobs that depend on these services.

tools.description: START HERE to set up outage alerts for a user. One call, no account or API key. tools.name: get_alert_stack
tools.description: Read a stack you created: its services and their current status, alert rules, delivery channels (including whether an email is confirmed), firing alerts and recent deliveries. Needs the stack id and its management token.

tools.name: update_alert_stack
tools.description: Add or remove services, add an email or webhook destination, publish or hide a read-only public status page, or rename a stack you created. New emails get a confirmation link. Needs the stack id and its management token.

tools.name: send_test_alert
tools.description: Send a test alert to every active channel of a stack right now (confirmed emails, webhooks, browser push) so the user can see what alerts look like. Needs the stack id and its management token.

tools.name: delete_alert_stack
tools.description: Permanently delete a stack and stop all its alerts. Only do this when the user asks. Needs the stack id and its management token.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: Recent incidents for a service: official incidents from its status page (when available) plus verdict changes WhatsDownNow detected.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_alert_stack, update_alert_stack · Private data: create_alert_stack, get_alert_stack, update_alert_stack, send_test_alert, rotate_alert_stack_key, delete_alert_stack · Public sink: create_alert_stack, get_alert_stack, update_alert_stack, send_test_alert, request_service · Destructive: update_alert_stack, delete_alert_stack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_alert_stack, update_alert_stack · Private data: create_alert_stack, get_alert_stack, update_alert_stack, send_test_alert, rotate_alert_stack_key, delete_alert_stack · Public sink: create_alert_stack, get_alert_stack, update_alert_stack, send_test_alert, request_service · Destructive: update_alert_stack, delete_alert_stack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
